2608.10875.title: VibeLifeBench: Can Your Life Agent Be Proactive and Persistent in a Living World?
2608.10875.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed as personal assistants. Existing evaluations, however, mostly use short, self-contained requests in static environments. Everyday life assistance is different. A task runs for weeks rather than minutes. The world keeps changing while the agent is not being prompted. Many constraints are never stated outright. An agent that merely answers the request in front of it will fail at such a task. What is needed instead is an agent that stays proactive and consistent. It decides on its own when to act, when to ask, and when to stay silent. It notices changes that nobody announced. It keeps one plan coherent from the first day to the last. No current benchmark measures this. We introduce VibeLifeBench, a benchmark of 200 long-horizon tasks across ten everyday-life domains. Each task is a scripted multi-week timeline in a simulated world of 22 mock services. The world advances on its own clock, and many of its changes are silent, so only an agent that re-inspects the world discovers them. Every task is graded by fine-grained, weighted checks that read only what the agent actually left behind, covering the end state, the timeliness of its actions, and whether it upheld the implicit constraints. We evaluate seven frontier models. All of them score low, which shows how far current agents are from assisting with real life. We will open-source all tasks, environments, and the evaluation framework.
2608.10875.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）代理人越來越多地被用作個人助理。然現有的評估大多使用靜態環境中的短小、自足的請求。日常生活中的協助則有所不同。一個任務的執行時間是幾週而非幾分鐘。在代理人未被提示的情況下，世界不斷變化。許多限制從未明言。僅僅回答眼前請求的代理人將無法完成這樣的任務。所需的是一個主動且一致的代理人。它自行決定何時行動、何時詢問以及何時保持沉默。它注意到沒有人公告的變化。它從第一天到最後一天保持一個計劃的一致性。目前沒有任何基準能測量這一點。我們介紹VibeLifeBench，這是一個涵蓋十個日常生活領域的200個長期任務的基準。每個任務都是在一個模擬世界中由22個虛擬服務構成的腳本化多週時間線。這個世界以自己的時鐘推進，許多變化是靜默的，因此只有重新檢查世界的代理人才能發現它們。每個任務都通過細緻的加權檢查進行評分，這些檢查僅讀取代理人實際留下的內容，涵蓋最終狀態、行動的及時性以及是否遵守隱含的限制。我們評估了七個前沿模型。它們的得分都很低，這顯示了當前代理人在協助現實生活方面的距離。我們將開源所有任務、環境和評估框架。
